answer: Jittered Beacon Window: each agent emits a beacon at an interval equal to last-tx-hash plus seeded jitter, encoding live state into traffic shape. Validators reject any 60 s burst whose inter-arrival variance breaks a velvet-smooth envelope (>2 ms²). An attacker running N fakes pays N × per-identity state memory plus hash-per-pulse compute, since every desynced voyage of pulses collapses the cluster.
